title: Signal
tagline: Chat with Hermes over Signal, from a signal-cli device linked to your account
description: Runs the signal-cli daemon on the compose network (http://signal-cli:8080, no host port) with the host store in SIGNAL_CLI_DATA_DIR bind-mounted, so the daemon can read every message and contact of the linked account. The default profile's gateway receives direct messages from SIGNAL_ALLOWED_USERS, replies, and delivers cron output to SIGNAL_HOME_CHANNEL; the browser profile gets the same variables for WebUI sends, with its Signal adapter disabled so only one gateway receives. api-server gets nothing. There is no MCP server: the agent has no tool that searches the store. Before enabling, link signal-cli on the host and set SIGNAL_ACCOUNT in .env. Disabling clears the seeded variables and never touches the store. See docs/signal.md.

store.dataLeaves: Messages to and from the linked Signal account go through Signal's servers, end-to-end encrypted, and replies the agent writes are sent from that account.

postInstallMessage: Run `make hermes-recreate` so the default and browser gateways load the Signal variables. Stop any signal-cli daemon on the host first: only one process may receive for the account.
